terra.problem: The line says Asa defeated Zerah at Mareshah. The battle formation was near Mareshah, in the Valley of Zephathah; say “near Mareshah.”
Eliezer was from Mareshah, but 2 Chronicles 20:35–37 does not say he prophesied there. The ships were built at Ezion-geber.
Micah 1:15 addresses Mareshah and predicts a conqueror, but it does not say Micah gave the warning at Mareshah or that the conquest had already happened.
Some words may be difficult for a fifth-grade reader, including “fortified,” “prophesied,” and “allying.” Simpler alternatives include “strengthened,” “gave God’s message,” and “joining forces.”
